passages.heading: Welcome
passages.passage_text: Welcome to Maple Ridge Services. This guide explains what to expect during your first weeks, from your first-day schedule to the training you must complete. Your manager and the HR Service Desk can answer questions this guide does not cover.

passages.heading: Your first day
passages.passage_text: New employees start on a Monday. Arrive at 8:30 a.m. and check in at the front desk in the lobby of Building A. After check-in, you will have your badge photo taken. New-hire orientation runs from 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. in Room 204. In the afternoon, you will meet your manager and team.

passages.heading: What to bring on your first day
passages.passage_text: Bring two forms of identification to verify your eligibility to work, and your bank details for direct deposit. You will complete your required new-hire forms during orientation. For a list of those forms and their deadlines, see HR-03, Required Forms.

passages.heading: Your manager and onboarding buddy
passages.passage_text: Your manager will set your goals for your first 90 days. You will also be paired with an onboarding buddy, a coworker from your team who helps you settle in. You and your buddy will meet once a week for your first 30 days.

passages.heading: Laptop and account setup
passages.passage_text: You will receive your laptop on your first day. You must change your temporary password and set up two-step sign-in within 24 hours. If you have trouble signing in, contact the IT Help Desk at extension 4357.

passages.heading: Required training
passages.passage_text: All new employees must complete three online training modules within their first 14 days: Workplace Safety, Information Security, and Code of Conduct. Each module takes about 45 minutes. Your manager can see when you have finished each one.

passages.heading: Work hours and timekeeping
passages.passage_text: Standard work hours are 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday, with a one-hour lunch break. Hourly employees must record their hours in the timekeeping system at the end of each workday. Managers approve timesheets every Friday.

passages.heading: Introductory period
passages.passage_text: Your first 90 days are an introductory period. Your manager will meet with you at 30 days to check on your progress and again at 90 days for a formal review. The introductory period helps you and your manager confirm that the role is a good fit.

passages.heading: Parking and building access
passages.passage_text: Employees may park for free in Lot C. You must wear your badge and use it to enter every building. If you lose your badge, report it to Security within 24 hours so it can be deactivated and replaced.

passages.heading: Who to contact
passages.passage_text: For questions about your role or schedule, start with your manager. For questions about pay, benefits, or HR policies, contact the HR Service Desk at extension 2200, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. For benefits details, see HR-02, Benefits.
